question: Who was elected pope in May 2025, and what name did he take?
text: Cardinal **Robert Francis Prevost** was elected pope on May 8, 2025, and took the name **Leo XIV**. ([vatican.va](https://www.vatican.va/content/leo-xiv/en/biography/documents/biografia_leone-xiv.html?utm_source=openai))
